part.text:
Fixed the `--word-regexp` offset bug in `crates/regex/src/word.rs:143`. The fast path assumed the first codepoint of a word match was always a `\W` delimiter, but at any line start the zero-width line anchor can match instead, leaving the first codepoint as part of the actual pattern. It now checks whether the match starts at a line boundary before stripping.

Validated with:
- `cargo test --test integration` — 285 passed
- `cargo test -p grep-regex` — 27 passed
- `r2574` regression test now passes.
